name: Max Planck Schools (Cognition, Matter to Life, Photonics, Biomedical AI)
host: Max Planck Schools (Max Planck Society & German universities)
amount: Funded doctoral (and integrated master's/PhD) positions – check official page
fields: Cognitive science, physics/chemistry/biology, photonics, biomedical AI
note: Four cross-institution graduate schools; Matter to Life is an integrated 5-year master's/PhD and Cognition accepts bachelor's graduates. Cognition interviews are on 23–24 Feb 2027.

name: Manchester President's Doctoral Scholar Award
amount: Tuition (home or international rate) + UKRI-level stipend (£21,805 in 2026/27) + £1,000/yr enhancement + up to £20,000 research training (S&E)
note: Flagship Manchester PhD scholarship open to all nationalities; in some faculties you are nominated by your prospective supervisor, so contact them early. Studentships start in Sept/Oct 2027.
